best_vs_H3.meaning: Full-period same-entry continuation helps, but before 2026 the larger improvement comes from omitting otherwise losing H3 entries. These are historical log-wealth path terms, not independent causal effects or additive percentage returns.

remaining_opportunity_evidence.limit: No delayed entry was simulated. These observations do not prove all deferred-entry rules ineffective; they remove the immediate account-specific rationale for prioritizing one now.

exposure_and_frequency.meaning: Additional continuation has a genuine holding-time and turnover cost. H6 renewal is a counterexample to simply extending the successful H3 renewal design.
